new_content_summary.dt_reactor_claim: Polomac can achieve DT reactor conditions at 2–3 T (half ITER's 5.3 T field), citing 'higher confinement efficiency of the poloidal configuration'. Unvalidated claim — no confinement scaling or Q analysis.

summary.note: No not-yet-sourced gaps exist in Section 6. Iter-4 opportunistically retrieved the full text of the JTSP 2024 paper (previously abstract-only), which provides significant new technical detail: DD burning condition factor (142× DT), claimed DD plasma parameters (100–200 keV, ~10²¹ m⁻³, 20–40 s τE), prototype ECRH heating (2–8 GHz, 5–10 kW), development timeline, and indication of PSI particle path analysis contract.
